selection: Eight existing initial-policy draws, including a known pass and a known failure under this reward and capped completion rule; hence 1..7 successes regardless of any unknown cached judgments

provenance.verifier: saved NeMo rescoring of retained initial-policy draws

cap_interpretation: Reuse initial-policy outcomes; responses over the cap fail require_completed_action. Exclude exact cap/EOS boundaries and prompts exceeding the new prompt limit.
limitations: This establishes mixed rewards in the saved eight-draw groups. New stochastic training groups need not be mixed. Historical prompt tokenization and sampling parameters are retained; no new sampling was performed.
